faq.a2: Yes, upon successful completion of your course, you will receive a globally recognized certificate.

hero.title: We provide education that creates new opportunities

story.title: Our Story
story.text: Polyglot Academy was founded to shape a new standard of language education in Armenia. Our mission is to provide effective, accessible, and internationally recognized education to every learner—regardless of age, prior knowledge, or schedule. Our team continuously refines our programs, following global educational trends and creating an environment where progress is an expected outcome, not a coincidence.
